question: If what is other than the free self is empty, can liberation be a separate thing?
premises: Anything other than the free self is empty.
An empty something cannot constitute a real separate liberation.
A real separate liberation would require a distinct name and status.
inference: Therefore there is no liberation as a separate entity apart from the free self, not even in name.
plain_english: Anything apart from the free self is empty. Since that is so, there is no separate thing called liberation, and it does not even deserve a separate name.
